coupling.edge_source: audit_intersegmental.cross_edges official T1/T2/T3 edges at absolute synapse floor 5
coupling.sign_source: fetch_manc.nt_signs predicted_nt: acetylcholine +1; GABA/glutamate -1; unknown omitted
coupling.row_normalization: each post-leg row divided by its own absolute signed raw K row sum; fixed anatomy-only input scaling
coupling.shuffled_rule: permute signed nonzero raw K entries across the fixed real nonzero mask
coupling.random_rule: independently permute raw magnitudes and signs across the fixed real nonzero mask

half_period_ceiling.rule: search through the nearest integer control-step half-period; no larger delay searched

source.definition: neutral common-frequency clock with seeded independent initial phases; no tripod offsets

criterion.phase_locked: maximum ordinary variance of every pairwise phase difference over final third is below threshold
criterion.bounded: maximum absolute phase step and step change reuse existing clean thresholds

calibration.selection_rule: Among admissible cells, select the one with the smallest per_hop_steps, breaking ties by the largest gain. Selection uses only the neutral phase-locked and bounded criteria across all three conditions.
